task: Investigate in the Hugging Face documentation how to utilize the 'Trainer' API for training a model on a custom dataset, and note the configurable parameters of the Trainer class.
answer: How to use the Trainer API on a custom dataset (Hugging Face docs, https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/training): (1) load/prepare your dataset (datasets.load_dataset or your own Dataset object) and preprocess it with a tokenizer/processing class; (2) configure training hyperparameters via TrainingArguments (e.g. learning_rate, num_train_epochs, per_device_train_batch_size, output_dir, eval_strategy, save_strategy, logging); (3) instantiate trainer = Trainer(model=model, args=training_args, train_dataset=..., eval_dataset=..., data_collator=..., processing_class=tokenizer, compute_metrics=...); (4) call trainer.train() to train/fine-tune, and optionally trainer.evaluate() and trainer.push_to_hub(). Configurable parameters of the Trainer class constructor (https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main_classes/trainer): model, args, data_collator, train_dataset, eval_dataset, processing_class, model_init, compute_loss_func, compute_metrics, callbacks, optimizers, preprocess_logits_for_metrics; the args parameter takes TrainingArguments, which exposes the bulk of training configuration (optimizer, scheduler, batch sizes, epochs, learning rate, logging/evaluation/saving strategy, mixed precision, distributed settings, etc.).
